result.notes: I set requires_unknown_facts to false. The ordinance covers ordinary rental housing; the owner-occupied 2-family exemption cannot be checked by an address lookup, so it stays listed in unverifiable_exemptions. I set supersedes_state_rule to null because no document addresses how this ordinance relates to state law. I removed the G.L. c. 151B reference from the summary because it does not appear in any document. I kept owner_occupied_exemption_max_units at 2 because the source names 2-family dwellings. The source does not say whether owner-occupied single-family dwellings are also exempt.
